fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Detects the execution of other scripts using the Node executable packaged with Adobe Creative Cloud
fields.name: Node Process Executions
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="windows" and (tgt.process.image.path contains "\\Adobe Creative Cloud Experience\\libs\\node.exe" and (not tgt.process.cmdline contains "Adobe Creative Cloud Experience\\js")))
